description: This Java class 'ConceptAttributeTypeEditor' extends 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' to provide property editing capabilities for 'ConceptAttributeType' objects within the OpenMRS framework. It retrieves 'ConceptAttributeType' instances by ID or UUID using the 'ConceptService' obtained via 'Context'.

classes.name: ConceptAttributeTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting string representations into 'ConceptAttributeType' objects, facilitating data binding in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ConceptAttributeType' object by its ID using the ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ConceptAttributeType' object by its UUID using the ConceptService.
